I replied to Dana in their DM to confirm the change: Dock 15 is now the dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups. I told them it stays private.

Your instructions say to check GBrain first, so I searched it for Tamsin Cold Chain. It had nothing about which dock Dana uses. It did return some notes on other Tamsin Cold Chain topics, but none of them were relevant here.

I chose not to save the dock note to GBrain. The brain is shared and other people can read it, so saving it would break Dana's request to keep it between us. The note stays only in Dana's DM, where they can ask me about it later.
